name: Stash
description: Stash is a private "save anything" inbox with a brain. It replaces that Discord channel, Telegram "Saved Messages", or notes file where you dump links, screenshots, code snippets, quotes, and reminders — except here everything you save is automatically understood, filed, and answerable.
short_desc: Hoard everything, find anything — your private on-device AI inbox
author: Stash
